mapper.sql: T1.ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, T1.ASSET_NAME AS ASSET_NAME, T1.GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID, T1.SYSTEM_ID AS SYSTEM_ID, T1.ASSET_KIND_CD AS ASSET_KIND_CD, T1.TECH_ROLE_CD AS TECH_ROLE_CD, T1.ENV_CD AS ENV_CD, T1.TIER_CD AS TIER_CD, T1.SERVICE_MODEL_CD AS SERVICE_MODEL_CD, T1.DEPLOY_MODEL_CD AS DEPLOY_MODEL_CD, T1.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, T1.OS_NAME AS OS_NAME, T1.OS_VERSION AS OS_VERSION, T1.OS_EOL_DATE AS OS_EOL_DATE, T1.REMARK AS REMARK, T1.REG_USER_ID AS REG_USER_ID, T1.REG_DTM AS REG_DTM, T1.CHG_USER_ID AS CHG_USER_ID, T1.CHG_DTM AS CHG_DTM
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT T1 WHERE T1.ASSET_ID = #{assetId}
SELECT FROM TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT T1 WHERE T1.ASSET_ID = #{assetId}
SELECT ENDPOINT_ID, ENDPOINT_TYPE_CD, ADDRESS, PORT_NO, PROTOCOL_CD, PRIMARY_YN FROM TB_IF_NETWORK_EP_PILOT WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} ORDER BY PRIMARY_YN DESC, ENDPOINT_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_MW_INSTALL_PILOT WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_DB_INSTANCE_PILOT WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId}

SELECT I.TEMPLATE_ID AS TEMPLATE_ID, I.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, I.ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_TYPE_CD AS ITEM_TYPE_CD, I.REQUIRED_YN AS REQUIRED_YN, I.SORT_NO AS SORT_NO, A.ATTR_VALUE AS ATTR_VALUE FROM TB_IF_SURVEY_ITEM_PILOT I LEFT JOIN TB_IF_ASSET_ATTR_PILOT A ON A.ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND A.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID WHERE I.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND I.TEMPLATE_ID IN #{tid} ORDER BY I.TEMPLATE_ID ASC, I.SORT_NO ASC, I.ITEM_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT SET ASSET_NAME=#{assetName}, GROUP_ID=#{groupId}, SYSTEM_ID=#{systemId}, ASSET_KIND_CD=#{assetKindCd}, TECH_ROLE_CD=#{techRoleCd}, ENV_CD=#{envCd}, TIER_CD=#{tierCd}, SERVICE_MODEL_CD=#{serviceModelCd}, DEPLOY_MODEL_CD=#{deployModelCd}, STATUS_CD=#{statusCd}, OS_NAME=#{osName}, OS_VERSION=#{osVersion}, OS_EOL_DATE=#{osEolDate}, REMARK=#{remark}, CHG_USER_ID=#{chgUserId}, CHG_DTM=#{chgDtm} WHERE ASSET_ID=#{assetId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_ASSET_ATTR_PILOT WHERE ASSET_ID=#{assetId} AND ITEM_ID=#{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_IF_ASSET_ATTR_PILOT (ASSET_ID, ITEM_ID, ATTR_VALUE, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{itemId}, #{attrValue}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_IF_ASSET_ATTR_PILOT SET ATTR_VALUE=#{attrValue}, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt} WHERE ASSET_ID=#{assetId} AND ITEM_ID=#{itemId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT WHERE ASSET_ID IN #{assetId}
DELETE FROM TB_IF_ASSET_ATTR_PILOT WHERE ASSET_ID IN #{assetId}
